Generate an action sheet, then turn its frames into a looping animation.

**Editor adaptation · Multi-step workflow · Not independently tested**

### Required inputs

- An image-generation tool and a file-processing tool.

<details>
<summary>Prompt</summary>

#### Step 1

```text
Draw a pixel-art male goblin performing one bow-and-arrow action across 16 consecutive frames. Arrange the sequence as a sprite sheet with consistent scale and alignment.
```

#### Step 2

```text
Separate the sprite sheet into frames and assemble a looping GIF. Inspect the loop for position jumps and frame-order mistakes.
```

[View this case on Image 2.5](https://image-2-5.com/prompt/community-goblin-archer-animation?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=awesome-gpt-image-2-5-prompts&utm_content=detail--en--goblin-archer-animation)

</details>

### Make it your own

Follow the steps in order. Reuse prior outputs where required and check external processing before starting.

### Notes

- The source compares GPT Image 2.5 with an older model. Open the post and use the first demonstration for the 2.5 example.
- The recipe is adapted; frame alignment and smooth motion are not guaranteed.

<details>

#### 步骤 1

```text
用像素风绘制男性哥布林拉弓射箭的一组连续动作，共 16 帧。排列为精灵表，保持角色大小和对齐一致。
```

#### 步骤 2

```text
把精灵表拆分为单帧并组装循环 GIF，检查循环中的位置跳动与帧顺序错误。
```

</details>
